cases.name: toy_help
cases.stdout_tail:
usage: run_toy.py [-h] [--stage {train,freeze,test}] [--output OUTPUT]
                  [--protocol PROTOCOL] [--kappas KAPPAS [KAPPAS ...]]
                  [--seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]] [--budget BUDGET]
                  [--lower-steps LOWER_STEPS]
                  [--optimizer {ddqn,pg,ppo-surrogate}] [--quick]
                  [--allow-test] [--threads {1,2}] [--max-rss-gib MAX_RSS_GIB]
                  [--min-free-disk-gib MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB]
                  [--wall-seconds WALL_SECONDS]

Train and evaluate the repaired source-entry composer on frozen task splits.
The default run uses five coupling levels and three seeds. --quick is an
interface smoke run, not evidence for the paper. Test access is a separate,
explicit command after checkpoint/code/protocol freezing.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stage {train,freeze,test}
  --output OUTPUT
  --protocol PROTOCOL
  --kappas KAPPAS [KAPPAS ...]
  --seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]
  --budget BUDGET
  --lower-steps LOWER_STEPS
  --optimizer {ddqn,pg,ppo-surrogate}
  --quick
  --allow-test
  --threads {1,2}
  --max-rss-gib MAX_RSS_GIB
  --min-free-disk-gib MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB
  --wall-seconds WALL_SECONDS

cases.name: traffic_help
cases.stdout_tail:
usage: run.py [-h] [--scene-dir SCENE_DIR] [--output OUTPUT]
              [--stage {prepare,sources,reference,sf,upper,evaluate,all}]
              [--device DEVICE] [--source-seed SOURCE_SEED]
              [--upper-seed UPPER_SEED] [--source-episodes SOURCE_EPISODES]
              [--reference-episodes REFERENCE_EPISODES] [--sf-steps SF_STEPS]
              [--upper-episodes UPPER_EPISODES] [--replays REPLAYS]
              [--threads THREADS] [--max-wall-seconds MAX_WALL_SECONDS]
              [--max-rss-gib MAX_RSS_GIB]
              [--min-free-disk-gib MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB]

Train/evaluate the current strict-entry traffic attention-DDQN pipeline.
Relative CLI paths are resolved from the working directory. This release
creates fresh scenario-bound sources; it never uses the historical sf_psi.pth.
All expensive stages have hash-checked completion receipts.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --scene-dir SCENE_DIR
  --output OUTPUT
  --stage {prepare,sources,reference,sf,upper,evaluate,all}
  --device DEVICE
  --source-seed SOURCE_SEED
  --upper-seed UPPER_SEED
  --source-episodes SOURCE_EPISODES
  --reference-episodes REFERENCE_EPISODES
  --sf-steps SF_STEPS
  --upper-episodes UPPER_EPISODES
  --replays REPLAYS
  --threads THREADS
  --max-wall-seconds MAX_WALL_SECONDS
  --max-rss-gib MAX_RSS_GIB
  --min-free-disk-gib MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB
